title: Mapping
description: One POLEARMS to SWORDS mapping. Shared by swords_mappings.yaml and a class config's override_mappings.

polearms.description: One POLEARMS path, or several for a many-to-one mapping whose mapper combines them. Without a mapper, [] takes every non-null item of an array and [N] takes item N.

swords.description: The SWORDS field this mapping writes.

selectors.description: One entry for each [key] bracket in the polearms or swords paths. A selector gets the array at its bracket and returns the items to keep; the label says in words which items those are.

label.description: The condition in words, like algorithm_id==1. The Confluence page puts it in the path.

fn.description: Name of a selector function in mappers_and_selectors.py. Without one the selector only documents the bracket, and the mapping needs a mapper that does the picking.

join.description: Join the mapped list of values into one string with this separator.

first.description: Take only the first non-null item of a [] path, so the result is one value.

fn.description: Name of a function in mappers_and_selectors.py.

args.description: Maps each function argument name to a POLEARMS path.
